===== TEXT =====
Vision Government Solutions

|

Lisbon, CT

|

Welcome

The Town of Lisbon contracted
with Vision Government to assist with the 2021 state mandated revaluation
project. Both the Assessor's Office and
Vision Government Solutions would like to thank Town of Lisbon residents for
their patience and cooperation throughout the 2021 Revaluation project.

Shown on this site are assessments of all taxable and exempt properties based on 70% of market value as of October 1, 2021. The previous assessments were as of October 1, 2016
To view the 2021 assessed values, please refer to the Valuation History section, found at the bottom of the taxpayer parcel. (The 2024 values showing in the Current Valuation section are not applicable at this time.)

Please
note that assessed values do not reflect any exemptions, which will be applied
to the final assessments.

Please do not use the current mill rate to
estimate your taxes. A new mill rate
will be established once the grand list is finalized and the budget completed.

(c) 2026 Vision Government Solutions, Inc. All rights reserved.
